title: Paper 17 R4 one-e-fold normalization audit

verdict.summary: R4 is irreducibly a premise on the current Paper 17 stack. Without R4, the theory yields a continuous c-family σ = c K_gauge.
verdict.strongest_derived_statement: Paper 17 plus standard modular theory fix the fiber modular flow exp(i t κ D), but do not fix the identification between modular time t and conformal depth λ.

core_no_go.statement: Let α_t^(κ) = Ad(exp(i t κ D)) be the fiber modular flow derived in Paper 17. Any continuous identification between modular time t and conformal depth λ has the form t = c λ. Therefore the physical transfer law without R4 is d(ln ω)/dλ = c κ; on the physical sector κ = K_gauge, so σ = c K_gauge.
proof_outline: Let φ: (R,+) -> (R,+) be continuous and additive.
Additivity gives φ(n λ) = n φ(λ) for all integers n and φ(q λ) = q φ(λ) for all rationals q.
Set c = φ(1). Then φ(q) = c q for all rationals q.
By continuity, φ(λ) = c λ for all real λ.
Hence the only continuous reparameterizations of an additive flow are constant rescalings.

routes.name: Canonical normalization coincidence
routes.reason: Canonical normalization of modular time and canonical normalization of λ do not fix the intertwiner between the two additive R-actions. The bridge remains t = c λ.

routes.name: Bisognano-Wichmann analogy
routes.reason: BW fixes normalization only when the modular group is proved to coincide with a specific geometric wedge symmetry. No IO theorem identifies the relevant thermal algebra with a radial-wedge modular action of the OS interior.

routes.name: Surface gravity / Hawking matching
routes.reason: Surface gravity fixes a temperature scale like κ/(2π), not the gauge-induced slope d(ln ω)/dλ. It does not determine the λ-to-modular-time conversion.

routes.name: Modular Hamiltonian additivity
routes.reason: Additivity fixes operator content, not the geometric readout parameter. exp(i t D⊗K̂_g) still yields a c-family once t is identified with c λ.

routes.name: Conformal weight / density argument
routes.reason: Density weights constrain carrier class, not the absolute width of one transfer cell in λ. No theorem derives a distinguished unit interval.

routes.name: Spectral flow quantization
routes.reason: D has integer spectrum, but exp(i t c κ D) is a valid one-parameter unitary group for any real c. Integrality does not fix c without an extra period condition.

routes.name: Unruh / detector response
routes.reason: Unruh/BW fixes boost-temperature normalization for wedge acceleration, not the extra gauge-sector transfer exponent across OS conformal depth.

routes.name: Information-theoretic / relative entropy
routes.reason: Relative entropy can fix a total modular difference only after a density measure along λ is specified. The per-unit-λ normalization is exactly the missing datum.

routes.name: Connes cocycle / relative modular route
routes.reason: No pair of faithful radial-slice states and no radial relative modular operator are constructed in Paper 17 for the gauge transfer. The available relative-modular machinery concerns later K_geom, not R4.

routes.name: Conformal-cell theorem
routes.reason: The March proof assumes that one physical transfer cell has width δ = 1 in λ. For arbitrary cell width δ, the same argument gives U(λ) = s^(λ/δ) and σ = (1/δ) K_gauge.

routes.name: Gaussian S² normalization
routes.reason: The Gaussian determinant ratio fixes the gauge scalar K_gauge = ln(1+γ²). It does not fix the separate bridge coefficient in σ = c K_gauge.

routes.name: Observational calibration
routes.reason: FIRAS can calibrate c numerically, but that is observational selection, not theorem. The exact match occurs at c_best != 1.

paper17_step3_fiber_kms.text: Step 3. On each fiber κ, the KMS state φ_κ is KMS for the dilation dynamics generated by κD (Paper 13, KMS rigidity R1). prior_claims_killed.reason: The proof identifies one conformal e-fold with one transfer cell. That is the missing normalization premise in disguised form.
The Gaussian-determinant corollary conflates normalization of K_gauge with normalization of the map from modular time to λ.

additional_physics_needed: A BW-type theorem identifying the IO thermal algebra modular flow with a specific radial geometric symmetry and its normalization.
A discrete radial-cell theorem deriving a distinguished cell width δ = 1 in λ from the OS/LQG geometry itself.
A detector-response or cocycle theorem proving that physical readout samples modular time and conformal depth with unit coefficient.
